QUOTE: **Tier 3 and tier 4 disagreements are inert.** Both accumulate and survive every stated tier, so only the label changes.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says tiers 3 and 4 accumulate and the distinction is inert, but never names fact-versus-guess as the load-bearing line. Its closing quote is about correcting guesses versus un-discovering facts, but it doesn't tie that line to the 3/4 distinction being inert. It also lacks the claim that they combine identically by design.
